killedBy: createRouteHost: the diagnostics trampoline (issue #247) answers null with no session, the session facts with one, and null again after detach
why: Passes whatever `live` held AT REGISTRATION rather than a closure that reads it per call. The host registers once, at construction, before any session exists -- so this hands the HUD `null` forever and no session's facts ever reach a report. The trampoline shape is the whole point of registering once, and this is the mistake that shape invites.
